description: Download and install Klever SDK tools to ~/klever-sdk/. Fetches the latest versions from the Klever CDN, installs binaries, and downloads required VM library dependencies. Supports macOS (arm64/amd64) and Linux. Run check_sdk_status first to see what is already installed.

tool.description: Which SDK component to install. "ksc" = smart contract compiler only, "koperator" = blockchain operator CLI + VM library, "all" = both ksc and koperator. Default: "all".

name: install_klever_sdk
